other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation data leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Transformations that learn from the data (like PCA or clustering) are fit on the entire training set before performing the cross-validation split. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, making the CV scores artificially optimistic.

other_failure_modes.name: Ignoring primary data modality
other_failure_modes.description: The agent completely ignores the primary data modality (e.g., images) provided for the task, relying exclusively on secondary tabular metadata. This discards the vast majority of the predictive signal.

summary: The agent successfully sets up a cross-validation loop and applies several feature engineering techniques to the tabular metadata. However, it commits a critical error by fitting data-dependent transformations (PCA, KMeans) on the entire training set before the CV split, causing validation leakage. Furthermore, it completely ignores the image data, which is the primary source of predictive signal for this multimodal task.
